_comment: VocaTrain_web: the backend recipe with scope VocaTrain_web/. Same build, tests, deploy (deploy-prod-winhost.sh publishes the API and the web app) and group vt-server, so web and backend requests never deploy at once.
The web components' bunit tests live in VocaTrain_backend/VocaTrain.WN.Core.Tests, outside this scope: a request that adds one, or changes the API, stops at needs_review for approval.

remote_busy_cmd's -EncodedCommand is base64 UTF-16LE of: $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; if (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match "install-service\.ps1" }) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }  (exit 0 = an install is running, 1 = free; ssh failure 255 = unknown, D18)
build_cmd: dotnet build VocaTrain_backend/VocaTrain.WN.Api -c Release -nologo -v q && dotnet build VocaTrain_web/VocaTrain.WN.Web -c Release -nologo -v q
